methodologyNotes: Roster of 11 portable tire inflators (cordless battery, 12V DC, AC/DC corded) selected for US search volume and price-tier coverage. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (fanttik.com, viaircorp.com, avidpowertool.com, avidpower.com, craftsman.com, dewalt.com, ryobitools.com, astroai.com) cross-checked against retailer listings (Scheels, MaxTool, Direct Tools Outlet, Life and Home, Home Depot) and review sources (Tool Craze, aircompressora.com, Automoblog). All entries independently re-verified 2026-06-20. priceUsd is the published US MSRP or current listed retail; where no published USD price exists for the exact config it is null. max_pressure_psi is stated maximum working PSI; nozzle_attachments is the count of included adapters/tips beyond the primary chuck where explicitly stated (null when the manufacturer page does not state a count). Booleans reflect confirmed feature presence (true) or confirmed/unstated absence (false/null). accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Fanttik X8 APEX Tire Inflator
products.priceNote: Current sale price on fanttik.com; regular MSRP $99.99
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Fanttik product page 2026-06-20: 150 PSI max, dual-screen LCD (±1 PSI), four preset modes (bicycle/motorcycle/car/ball), 2-mode LED (normal+SOS), auto shutoff at preset pressure. Current price $69.99 (30% off regular $99.99) confirmed on page. CORRECTED releaseDate 2023->2022: The Gadgeteer review of the X8 APEX is dated April 2022, establishing 2022 launch. CORRECTED nozzle_attachments 3->null: the product page does not state a specific adapter count, so null rather than guess. No deflation mode mentioned.

products.name: DeWalt DCC020IB 20V MAX Cordless Inflator
products.priceNote: Regular retail (Scheels, Lowe's); currently discounted ~$149 at some retailers; tool only, battery sold separately
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-20: 160 PSI max confirmed across DeWalt, Scheels, Acme. Three power sources (20V battery, 12V DC, 110V AC), digital gauge with auto shutoff, onboard LED, high-volume deflation port mode confirmed, three included accessories (high-pressure tapered nozzle, Presta valve adapter, inflator needle). Regular price $169 (Scheels/Lowe's); note current sale pricing near $149 at several dealers. CORRECTED source.url to the live dewalt.com product slug.

products.name: Milwaukee M12 Compact Inflator (Tool Only) 2475-20
products.priceNote: Listed price per MaxTool; bare-tool street price is often lower (~$79-99 at Home Depot/Woot); tool only, battery sold separately
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-20: 120 PSI max, TrueFill auto shutoff, illuminated digital LCD (target+current pressure; counts as digital_gauge, backlit only, no separate work light so built_in_light=false), preset target pressure.
